style: stylised hand-painted game asset, chunky readable shapes, matte, ukiyo-e woodblock colours, single object centred on a plain light grey background, no text
scale: studs = intended longest axis, sized against a ~5.5-stud R15 avatar
colour: PAINT every mesh with paint_texture.py from this palette (the 'paint' line per asset); never concept projection. Kit meshes keep the phase accent on the most visible surface.
budgets: kit meshes are worn by up to 12 players, so they stay light; SpiderLilyCluster is instanced in the thousands, so it is the cheapest of all
routes: Planned route: roblox-3d-model (concept image -> image-to-3D -> Blender decimate and paint -> upload as Model). Blocked today: Blender is not installed and HF_TOKEN is unset. Pre-authorised fallback if still blocked in section 3: Studio's built-in generate_mesh / generate_procedural_model tools via the roblox-studio MCP, painted to this palette; primitive stand-ins are never shipped.
